messages.content: what is different about i found a book and i found the book?
a book can be a new book in the conversation. the book usually is a specific one that the people can understand from context.
make that explanation shorter.
a book can be new to the conversation. the book is a specific one understood from context.
make a short example.
i found a book on the floor. the book was blue.
now make the place the table instead.
i found a book on the table. the book was blue.
why the in the last sentence?
now you are talking about the book you just found, rather than another new book.
can the be clear before someone has seen the object?
yes, if context makes it clear. please close the door can work when there is one door both people understand.
only give the book example again.
i found a book on the floor. the book was blue.
write a story about a child finding a coin near a friends chair. being near the chair should not tell him for sure whose coin it is.

a child found a coin on the floor near the chair where his friend had been sitting. he took it in his hand and thought it might be hers. before giving it to her, he asked whether she had lost any money. she looked and said she still had all her coins. his brother then remembered that he had lost one there while moving the chair. the child gave it back after hearing where and when it had happened. finding the coin near one person had been a reason to ask, not enough to choose whose it was.
why did he first ask his friend?
the coin was near her chair, so he thought it might be hers.
did she say it was hers?
no. she said she still had all her coins.
what gave another reason for whose coin it was?
his brother remembered that he had lost one there while moving the chair.
give that in fewer words.
his brother said he had lost a coin there.
why not say the friend had told a lie?
nothing in the story gives a reason to say that. the coin could have come from another person, and the brother gave that information.
finish with the floor clear again.
he gave the coin to his brother and looked once more under the chair. then they put the chair back and returned to their game.
we started a film last night, but then we talked through most of it. i liked the conversation more.
you went in with one idea and found something else you enjoyed while you were together.
i do not want to say the film was wrong or not good. we just kept talking.
you can like the conversation more without saying the film was wrong.
explain that more simply.
you can enjoy one thing more without making the other thing wrong.
use words i know in that last answer.
you can like the conversation more without saying the film was wrong.
write one sentence about what happened.
we started a film, but spent most of the evening talking, and i enjoyed that.
can i still watch the film another day?
yes. choosing to talk last night does not stop you from watching it later.
only give the sentence about the evening.
we started a film, but spent most of the evening talking, and i enjoyed that.
can close mean near and also be something i do to a door?
yes. the school is close to home is about being near. please close the door asks for something to be done.
can you use both in one sentence?
please close the door that is close to the table.
why can the same word do both things there?
one use asks you to make the door closed. the other says the door is near the table.
make that explanation shorter.
one is about closing the door. the other is about the place.
what if i only say it is close?
then the person may need more context to know what you mean.
what question could they ask?
close to what?
only give a sentence about a school being near home.
the school is close to home.
my friend wrote a long message about a book and then said what do you think. i do not know if they mean the book or their plan to read it.
you can ask which part they want your answer about. that is more useful than choosing a question they may not have asked.
write a short question.
do you mean what i think of the book, or whether your plan to read it works?
can you make it sound more kind?
could you tell me which part you want me to answer about: the book or your reading plan?
only give the part after the question about which part.
the book or your reading plan?
why not answer about both?
you can if that would help, but it may be more than they want. asking first can keep your answer on the real question.
make that explanation shorter.
you can answer both if useful, but asking first helps you know what they want.
only give the short question again.
do you mean what i think of the book, or whether your plan to read it works?
i have four books. my friend gives me one of hers, and i give her one of mine. how many books do i have now?
you have four books now. you got one and gave one away.
are they the same four books as before?
no. the number is the same, but one of the books is different.
explain which part stayed the same.
you still have four books.
can you know which story i gave her?
no. you gave the number and the change, but not which book it was.
what if we give the same books back again?
then you have your original four, if you each return the book you got from the other.
why does four not tell us which books?
a number gives how many books there are, not which four they are.
make that explanation shorter.
how many and which books are different questions.
only give how many i have after both changes.
four books.
write a story about a child doing a writing task who needs one word, not someone to write the whole page for her.

a child was writing about the garden. she wanted to write about one of the green leaves on a tree, but could not remember the word for just one. she asked her brother for help. he began telling her a sentence about a large tree in the park. she stopped him and explained that she wanted to keep her own sentence. she only needed the word leaf. he gave her the word and let her finish the line herself. when she read the page later, it was still her story, with one small part of help from someone else.
why did she stop his sentence?
she wanted her own sentence, not a different story written for her.
can you know she wanted no help at all?
no. she asked for help with one word. that is different from asking for no help.
write her request more clearly.
could you help me find one word? i want to write the rest myself.
what could her brother ask first?
what are you trying to name in your sentence?
finish with her reading her own page.
she used leaf in the line and kept writing. later, she read the whole page to him and said thank you for the word.
is did anyone come the same as did everyone come?
no. did anyone come can be answered yes if one person came. did everyone come needs the whole group for yes.
make that explanation shorter.
anyone can ask about one person coming. everyone asks about the whole group.
there were three friends, and one came. answer both.
yes, someone came. no, not everyone came.
now two came.
yes, someone came. no, not everyone came.
now all three came.
yes, someone came, and yes, everyone came.
why can anyone still have yes when all came?
because if all three came, then someone came too. the first question does not ask that only one came.
only answer everyone for when one friend came.
no, not everyone came.
i told my sister i would call in the morning. now i need to call after lunch instead. help me say the change clearly.
i need to change our call from morning to after lunch. would that work for you?
add that the day is tomorrow.
i need to change our call tomorrow from morning to after lunch. would that work for you?
can you keep tomorrow first so she sees the day?
tomorrow, could we move our call from the morning to after lunch?
why ask if it works instead of just telling her?
because changing your time may not work for her. with a question, she can tell you whether the new time works for her too.
make that explanation shorter.
you need to know whether she can talk at the new time.
give that as a question i can ask her.
can you talk at the new time?
only give the message again.
tomorrow, could we move our call from the morning to after lunch?
i tried to explain a story to my father, and i found a part i did not understand while talking.
when you tell a story, you can find a part that is not clear to you yet.
give that idea in fewer words.
telling the story can show you what is not clear.
that happened with why one person left the house. i knew they left, not why.
you knew what happened, but not why it happened.
make that reply shorter.
what happened was clear. why was still a question.
can you help me say that to my father?
i can tell you what happened in that part, but i still do not understand why the person left.
does that make the whole story impossible to understand?
not always. you can understand many parts and still have a question about one choice.
only give the sentence about what i know and do not know.
i can tell you what happened in that part, but i still do not understand why the person left.
write a story about a child using the back of an old page for a new drawing. the old writing should still be there.

a child needed paper for a drawing. her mother gave her a page with an old food list on one side and nothing on the other. she told the child to draw on the empty side. after making a picture of the house, the child turned it over and asked about the words on the back. her mother said the list had already been used, but the paper could still hold something new. they kept the drawing without saying the old words had never been there. one object had a past use and a new use, each on a different side.
why was the empty side useful?
it gave the child room to draw without writing over the old words.
did drawing make the old list false?
no. it gave the page a new use. it did not change the fact that the list had been used before.
can the paper have writing and still have an empty side?
yes. one side can have words while the other is empty.
what could the child ask before using another page?
is this side free for me to draw on?
finish with the picture put away.
she put the page inside a book with the drawing on top, so she could see it when she opened the book.
that helped. please do not give me another task.
you are welcome. i will leave it there.
can you say something kind without a question?
i hope it is useful when you need it.
now shorter.
i hope it helps.
only say goodbye.
goodbye.
